```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
library(RDML)
```

## The format registry

```r
rdmlFormats()
```

A registered format may contain a reader, writer, sniffer, aliases, priority,
capabilities, and API version.

## Register a reader

```r
rdmlRegisterFormat(
  name = "mydevice",
  extensions = "foo",
  apiVersion = 1L,
  capabilities = c("adp", "basicMetadata"),
  reader = function(fileName, ...) {
    # return rdmlType or rdmlImportData
  }
)
```

## Intermediate importer objects

Table-like formats should normally return `rdmlImportData`.

```r
series <- rdmlImportSeries(
  fdataType = "adp",
  fdata = fdata,
  description = description
)

parsed <- rdmlImportData(
  series = list(series),
  publisher = "My instrument",
  format = "mydevice"
)
```

`readRDML()` calls `rdmlBuildImport()` automatically for such a result.

Minimum description columns are:

```text
fdataName
expId
runId
reactId
target
```

Provide `sample`, `sampleType`, and `targetDyeId` when new metadata objects must
be created.

## Sniffers

A sniffer returns confidence from 0 to 1.

```r
mySniff <- function(fileName) {
  first <- readLines(fileName, n = 1L, warn = FALSE)

  if (length(first) && startsWith(first, "MYDEVICE")) {
    return(1)
  }

  0
}
```

This permits shared extensions such as `.txt` and `.csv`.

## Lossy conversions

```r
loss <- rdmlLossRecord(
  code = "unsupportedVendorField",
  message = "Vendor field X cannot be represented in RDML",
  path = "run.run1",
  details = list(field = "X")
)

parsed$losses <- list(loss)
```

The user's `loss = "warn"`, `"error"`, or `"allow"` setting controls how these
records are signalled.

## Module files

A module defines `rdmlModule()` and returns one or more registry
specifications.

```r
rdmlModule <- function() {
  list(
    name = "mydevice",
    extensions = "foo",
    reader = myReader,
    sniff = mySniff,
    apiVersion = 1L,
    capabilities = c("adp", "intermediate")
  )
}
```

Load it with:

```r
rdmlLoadModule("mydevice-module.R")
```

The historical factory name `rdml_module()` is also accepted.
